edits.anchor: But if your plans include a longer road trip through Hiroshima Prefecture or the wider Chugoku region, a rental car can give you more freedom to stop at smaller towns, scenic viewpoints and places that are harder to reach by public transport.
edits.fragment: Want a few ideas beyond the city? I've also written about our relaxed coastal drive around Kurahashi Island and little discoveries around Etajima. Both are for a different kind of Hiroshima day, after you've enjoyed the city itself.

targets.title: Yamaguchi Road Trip from Hiroshima: 2 Days to Tsunoshima & Motonosumi

edits.anchor: Don't mistake this for a short trip from Hiroshima. Eastern Yamaguchi is closer, but Tsunoshima and Motonosumi are much farther west. Allow a full two days or reduce the number of stops. Even for us, this was a very ambitious schedule.
edits.fragment: If one stop catches your eye, I've written separate photo diaries about our underground adventure at Mikawa Mu Valley, Motonosumi's red gates, Tsunoshima Bridge and the island, and what we ate at Karato Market. Pick whichever sounds most fun, rather than racing through all four.

targets.title: Tottori Road Trip: Detective Conan, Sand Art, Seafood & Rain at the Dunes

edits.anchor: Daytime for exploring, evening for a bath, then another area to visit the next morning. For a long east–west Tottori drive, having one overnight stop made a big difference.
edits.fragment: If you're spending another day in the San'in region, you could also cross into neighboring Shimane. On a separate trip we spent about five hours at Matsue Vogel Park among birds and flowers. It deserves plenty of time of its own.

targets.title: Kurashiki Bikan Historical Quarter: Parfaits, Denim Shops & Our Funny Canal Walk

edits.anchor: There I was, apparently shouting about fish at the picturesque river while everyone else admired the architecture. A very normal husband-and-wife sightseeing moment.
edits.fragment: There I was, shouting about a fish beside Kurashiki's beautiful old streets. Apparently, that particular attraction had an audience of one.

edits.anchor: I'm a fishing enthusiast, so little surprises like that are part of what makes a walk memorable for me. You may be more interested in the boats, buildings and swans. All perfectly reasonable choices.
edits.fragment: The old streets were beautiful, but I wasn't going to ignore a fish swimming right in front of me. That's what happens when you take a fishing enthusiast sightseeing.
